hooks.name: Secret Scan on Save
hooks.description: Scans for accidentally committed secrets on every file save.

action.command: git grep -nE "AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----|ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{36}|sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}" 2>/dev/null && echo "FAIL: Potential secret found in tracked files — rotate immediately and do not commit." >&2 || echo "PASS: No obvious secrets found."
